tools.name: freecad_worker_partdesign_datum_plane_create
tools.title: Worker Create PartDesign Datum Plane
tools.description: Create a PartDesign datum plane inside a worker Body, attached to a Body origin plane or another support object with optional offset. FreeCAD workflow policy: use Body Origin planes for base sketches; for ordinary holes/pockets on an existing cube/top/side face, attach the sketch directly to the selected planar FaceN, add external/reference geometry from that face's edges or vertices when needed, dimension the circle/profile, then use Hole or Pocket. Datum objects live inside a Body and are useful for arbitrary mirror planes, visible reference indicators, reusable offset/angled supports for multiple sketches, revolution/groove axes, loft/sweep section supports, datum chains, and LCS orientation references. A datum plane is basically redundant for support of one sketch, and a datum attached to generated faces has the same topological naming risk as a sketch attached to those faces.

attachment_plane.description: Origin plane to derive this datum from. The Body Origin may be hidden in GUI but is still addressable.

attachment_object.description: Optional support object for datum references, including origin plane, planar face, edge, vertex, or another datum.

attachment_subname.description: Support subelement such as Face1, Edge1, or Vertex1.

attachment_offset.description: Datum offset in the datum's local coordinate system; z is along the datum normal.

attachment_offset_vector.description: Datum XYZ offset in the datum's local coordinate system; z is along the datum normal.

allow_external_paths.description: Allow writes outside FREECAD_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT/server workspace.

compact_response.description: Return a compact worker response that omits repeated full document object dumps.

compact_execution.description: Alias for compact_response on worker tools.

tools.name: freecad_worker_sketch_create
tools.title: Worker Create Sketch
tools.description: Create a Sketcher object inside an in-memory worker document, optionally inside a PartDesign Body attached to XY/XZ/YZ origin plane, planar face, datum, or other support. FreeCAD workflow policy: use Body Origin planes for base sketches; for ordinary holes/pockets on an existing cube/top/side face, attach the sketch directly to the selected planar FaceN, add external/reference geometry from that face's edges or vertices when needed, dimension the circle/profile, then use Hole or Pocket. Datum objects live inside a Body and are useful for arbitrary mirror planes, visible reference indicators, reusable offset/angled supports for multiple sketches, revolution/groove axes, loft/sweep section supports, datum chains, and LCS orientation references. A datum plane is basically redundant for support of one sketch, and a datum attached to generated faces has the same topological naming risk as a sketch attached to those faces.

attachment_plane.description: Body Origin plane for base sketches or simple independent offsets.

attachment_object.description: Support object for the sketch. Use with attachment_subname='FaceN' for normal planar-face sketching, or with a datum/support object for reusable references.

attachment_subname.description: Support subelement such as Face1, Edge1, or Vertex1. For PartDesign face-local holes/pockets, use a planar FaceN selected from the target Body feature.

attachment_offset.description: Offset from the selected origin plane, planar face, or datum support.

attachment_offset_vector.description: XYZ offset from the selected origin plane, planar face, or datum support.

allow_external_paths.description: Allow writes outside FREECAD_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT/server workspace.

tools.name: freecad_partdesign_datum_plane_create
tools.title: Create PartDesign Datum Plane
tools.description: Create a PartDesign datum plane inside a Body, attached to a Body origin plane or another support object with optional offset. FreeCAD workflow policy: use Body Origin planes for base sketches; for ordinary holes/pockets on an existing cube/top/side face, attach the sketch directly to the selected planar FaceN, add external/reference geometry from that face's edges or vertices when needed, dimension the circle/profile, then use Hole or Pocket. Datum objects live inside a Body and are useful for arbitrary mirror planes, visible reference indicators, reusable offset/angled supports for multiple sketches, revolution/groove axes, loft/sweep section supports, datum chains, and LCS orientation references. A datum plane is basically redundant for support of one sketch, and a datum attached to generated faces has the same topological naming risk as a sketch attached to those faces.

attachment_plane.description: Origin plane to derive this datum from. The Body Origin may be hidden in GUI but is still addressable.

attachment_object.description: Optional support object for datum references, including origin plane, planar face, edge, vertex, or another datum.

attachment_subname.description: Support subelement such as Face1, Edge1, or Vertex1.

attachment_offset.description: Datum offset in the datum's local coordinate system; z is along the datum normal.

attachment_offset_vector.description: Datum XYZ offset in the datum's local coordinate system; z is along the datum normal.
